failure_type: wind / gusts + late detection + UAV too fast to react
explanation: The UAV collided with a moving obstacle after only 2.1 seconds of flight. The combination of a high cruise speed of 8.3 m/s and a 7.2 m/s tailwind reduced the reaction time to just 0.7 seconds between detection and the closest approach. This limited window, compounded by the late detection at 1.4 seconds, prevented the planner from successfully avoiding the collision.
